senses.en_definition: To continue or carry on with something.
To forward or pass on a letter, message, or other item to another recipient.

collocations.en: pass the letter on to the recipient

messages.en: I ran into an old school friend at the shop earlier. We hadn't seen each other in ten years!
Oh, who? Go on, tell me more. I want to know!
Amir! I didn't recognize him at first. It was only when he said hi that I remembered who he was.
The guests are at the front door. Can you let them in?
Yeah, I'll get the door now. Want me to make some drinks too?

senses.en_definition: Remaining in one place; not moving or changing location.
Still; continuing despite changes, difficulties, or opposition.

collocations.en: last for the rest of one's life

senses.en_definition: Fixed, stable, or unchanging in amount, condition, or arrangement.
Certainly; indicating that an event or outcome is assured.
Firm or resolute; unwavering in one's beliefs, intentions, or decisions.

messages.en: It's pouring. Are you still coming? If it's too much trouble, we can just meet another day.
I still want to come. My older brother can drop me off right outside the café. Wait inside for me, okay?

senses.en_definition: But; used to connect contrasting or opposing statements.
Yet; nevertheless; used to introduce something true despite what has just been stated.

collocations.en: but still strong enough to work hard

messages.en: Are you still coming? We're already at the restaurant.
I'm coming, but I'll be a bit late. The traffic's really bad right now.
Okay, no worries. We'll go ahead and order, then.
